baccarat--baccarat-the-havana-selection.description: Baccarat is a mild Davidoff brand made at the Camacho factory in Honduras, known for the sweetened cap on each cigar. The Havana Selection wraps Havana-seed Honduran filler and a Mexican binder in Connecticut Shade, with a maduro version alongside. Creamy and lightly woody, it picks up cocoa, leather and cedar as it burns; an easy, sociable smoke.

thirds.notes: The sweet cap meets cocoa, leather and a little pepper.
Much the same profile, with leather cutting more clearly through the sweetness.
Cedar joins in for a balanced finish.

baccarat--baccarat-barber-pole.description: Baccarat's first barber pole, a JR Cigars exclusive, spirals a dark Connecticut Broadleaf and a pale Connecticut Shade leaf around a Mexican binder and aged Honduran long filler. The broadleaf brings chocolate and pepper, the shade leaf creaminess, over leather and roasted nuts; a balanced, medium smoke for the afternoon.

thirds.notes: Earthy, sweet and peppery at first; the pepper eases into baking spice, leather and cream.
Bittersweet chocolate appears beside the cream and leather, and the pepper picks up again.
Pepper, chocolate and baking spice build, with cream ahead of roasted nuts and leather.

sources.title: JR Cigars Blending Room – Baccarat Barber Pole review

baccarat--baccarat-nicaragua.description: Baccarat Nicaragua brings more spice to the brand: a Cuban-seed Habano wrapper and Sumatra binder over Nicaraguan filler, made to Davidoff's standards. It stays smooth and approachable, built on black pepper and sweet spice, with roasted nuts and cocoa joining in the last third; a relaxed everyday smoke.

thirds.notes: Black pepper and sweet spice, simple and smooth.
Sweet spice takes the lead, leaving a peppery aftertaste.
Roasted nuts and cocoa join the pepper and spice for a fuller close.
